name: classify the binary's architecture
definition: Identify, through file-type/strings/metadata, that the artifact is machine code for an older (PDP-11) architecture and not a normal host executable.

name: coalesce per-module LLVM IR output into a single linkable bitcode module
definition: Gather and link the separately emitted IR modules into one combined module resolving cross-file references.
failure_mode: Undefined or duplicate symbols when assembling/linking the IR

name: compile and link a fortran library module with a main program
definition: drive gfortran over the .f90 module and main sources to produce a working native executable named as expected.
failure_mode: module-not-compiled-before-program or missing object/link step prevents the binary from being built

name: compute a probability distribution meeting forward/backward KL constraints
definition: Produce a probability array over a fixed vocabulary that satisfies both forward and reverse KL targets within a tolerance.
failure_mode: Wrong size, non-finite, or non-positive values fail the shape/value checks.
